title: Helicopter with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Rotor blades -->
  <rect x="18" y="12" width="64" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#5bc8e8"/>
  <rect x="46" y="8" width="8" height="10" rx="2" fill="#f0a030"/>
  <!-- Rotor mast -->
  <rect x="47" y="17" width="6" height="8" rx="2" fill="#f0a030"/>
  <!-- Tail boom -->
  <rect x="68" y="42" width="22" height="6" rx="3" fill="#e84a5f"/>
  <!-- Tail rotor -->
  <circle cx="91" cy="45" r="7" fill="#5bc8e8" opacity="0.9"/>
  <circle cx="91" cy="45" r="3" fill="#f0a030"/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="52" rx="24" ry="18" fill="#e84a5f"/>
  <!-- Body lighter panel -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="54" rx="16" ry="11" fill="#f27a8a"/>
  <!-- Cockpit window -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="48" rx="10" ry="8" fill="#8ad8f0"/>
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="48" rx="7" ry="5.5" fill="#b8ecff"/>
  <!-- Skids -->
  <rect x="28" y="70" width="30" height="4" rx="2" fill="#f0a030"/>
  <rect x="32" y="66" width="4" height="6" rx="1" fill="#f0a030"/>
  <rect x="50" y="66" width="4" height="6" rx="1" fill="#f0a030"/>
  <!-- Smiling face -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="48" r="2.2" fill="#3a1a20"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="48" r="2.2" fill="#3a1a20"/>
  <path d="M 44 54 Q 51 61 58 54" stroke="#3a1a20" stroke-width="2.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="54" r="2.5" fill="#ff9db0" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="54" r="2.5" fill="#ff9db0" opacity="0.8"/>
</svg>
